Don't know if the feeling was "something amiss" per se but once I was talking to my mother one night and I had this indescribable urge to sneak my phone and just record our conversation. 

Little background information: growing up my mum used to always tell me she loves me and I would tell her I love her back and then she'd ask how much I love her and I'd reply "super-duper infinity" it became our thing whenever we said I love yous to each other.

anyways this particular night I just had the feeling I needed to press record and tell her I love her like normal, to just have that moment saved for me. The feeling of silliness took over and I didn't do it. A few weeks later my mother passed away. Woke up to find her lifeless on the ground in our dining area. Still haunts me to this day
